# Pulse 1.0.400

- Books: a library look with a title and Import button, All / Reading / Finished filters, a staggered cover wall, a floating bar, a home page, collections with fanned covers, and categories of free books from the internet.
- Game Hub: the shelf is built again after a long absence (no black screen); Performance on Automatic is lighter on a phone.
- Game Hub: add your own HTML games (.html or a .zip with index.html); a delete button on the back cover (uninstall, remove a built-in game, or delete an HTML game); built-in games get a short description.
- Game Hub: Boxshelf's updates from beta.10 to beta.12 merged in: Find a game (the search button beside Menu), the manual reader, Mona Sans, and many fixes.
- Game Hub: Pulse badges from play time on the achievements wall.
- Game Hub: cases for Steam (blue), PC, Epic Games, GOG, Google Play, Android, EA, Ubisoft, Battle.net, itch.io, PlayStation 1 and 2, Xbox, NES, Super NES, Nintendo 64, GameCube, Wii, Wii U, DS and 3DS, with the platforms' own logos. Mix gives every game a random case.
- Game Hub: a game with no cover gets its box made from its icon and name; AMOLED black is a switch, off by default.
- Keyboard: a word typed wrong and corrected in two steps is learned as the last word at once.
- Keyboard: the extra row's held keys (Ctrl, Alt, Win, Shift, Fn) are let go when the keyboard closes or opens.
- Keyboard: a corrected word stays highlighted for most of a second.
- Floating keyboard: the whole Pulse keyboard in a window that stays on top of apps and games, moved by its handle, with or without a text box.
